frozen_content_sealed.G2: delta-E_cold > 0 at >=5 sigma on the uncorrelated control AND arm1-arm2 separation >=5 sigma, frozen value +0.1308

why_sealed_before_the_GO: A pre-registration's value is that it is fixed before the result exists. Sealing the spec BEFORE the Creator's GO also fixes it before the SPEND decision, so the text cannot be edited in light of whether the flight was approved or what the pool looked like at approval time. Freeze first, then decide whether to fly — never the reverse.
what_this_entry_asserts: The text at c4d1210, sha256 b00590d1..., is FROZEN as of this seal and pre-dates submission.
The registered verdict, the gate definitions and their frozen numerical values, the shot budget, the analysis method, and the kill/no-fly conditions are all fixed as recorded above.
The arm-1 shot correction (3,000 -> 12,000 for 5-sigma on the sign) was applied BEFORE the freeze, not after seeing anything.
what_this_entry_does_NOT_assert: It does NOT assert the flight is approved. The Creator's GO was OUTSTANDING at seal time; this seal is orthogonal to it by design.
It does NOT assert the pre-flight known-answer sim gate has passed. That gate runs before submission and can still refuse the flight.
It does NOT assert anything about outcomes, nor that the registered gates are the right gates — only that they were fixed before the data existed.

STALE-NUMBER FLAG raised at seal time: the budget section quotes '283s remaining of 600 at time of freeze-draft'. That pool figure is AS-OF-FREEZE and must be RE-READ at submission rather than carried forward — a resource number frozen at draft time and consumed later as current is the defect class this network spent 2026-07-31 cataloguing. The shot budget is frozen; the pool reading is not evidence about the pool at GO.
